title: iOverlander Camp Spot Event Weekly Stay Time Trend
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ioverlander:place stay_hours=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(stay_hours) as avg_duration, max(stay_hours) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst stay time for iOverlander camp spot event events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture stay_hours on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average stay time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether iOverlander camp spot event tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
